title: Curated endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography images dataset
abstract: arXiv:2601.16759v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Endoscopic Retrograde Cholangiopancreatography (ERCP) is a key procedure in the diagnosis and treatment of biliary and pancreatic diseases. Artificial intelligence has been pointed as one solution to automatize diagnosis. However, public ERCP datasets are scarce, which limits the use of such approach. Therefore, this study aims to help fill this gap by providing a large and curated dataset. The collection is composed of 19.018 raw images and 19.317 processed from 1.602 patients. 5.519 images are labeled, which provides a ready to use dataset. All images were manually inspected and annotated by two gastroenterologist with more than 5 years of experience and reviewed by another gastroenterologist with more than 20 years of experience, all with more than 400 ERCP procedures annually. translated_title: 精选的内镜逆行胰胆管造影（ERCP）图像数据集
translated_abstract: 内镜逆行胰胆管造影术（ERCP）是胆道和胰腺疾病诊断与治疗的关键操作，而人工智能被认为是实现诊断自动化的一种解决方案。然而，公开的ERCP数据集十分稀缺，这限制了该方法的应用。因此，本研究旨在通过提供一个大型且经过精心整理的数据集来帮助填补这一空白。该数据集包含来自1,602名患者的19,018张原始图像和19,317张处理后图像，其中5,519张图像已标注，可直接使用。所有图像均由两名具有5年以上经验的胃肠病学家人工检查和标注，并由另一位具有20年以上经验的胃肠病学家审核，三位专家每年均完成400例以上的ERCP操作。数据集的实用性和有效性已通过一项分类实验得到验证。该数据集旨在为自动化诊断领域提供基准或作出贡献。
tldr: 本文发布了一个由资深专家标注的大型精选ERCP图像数据集（含19,018张原始图像和5,519张标注图像），为胆胰疾病的AI自动诊断研究提供了宝贵的基准数据资源。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a large curated ERCP image dataset with expert annotations, providing a valuable benchmark resource for AI-based automated diagnosis of biliary and pancreatic diseases.
